Area.evidence_source: All participants have sought assistance in dealing with their trauma, to psychologists, psychiatrists or centres for victims of sexual violence. Initially, when they wanted to seek help, they were not aware that they could go to counselling centres for sexual violence survivors, being men. Later, they found out that help for them was available and they found great help. Ian felt it was important to always have the same counsellor as he did not want to tell his story all over again. He also mentioned that he enjoyed meeting his adviser and to just talk with him about everyday things and thus not always be talking about the violence. Most of them experienced the emergence of a new world when getting appropriate traumaspecific help.
